card.name: Number before a range 'to' value
card.fires_on: The last digit or percent sign of the first number in a numeric range, just before the word 'to' and the second number. Seen mostly in risk percentages such as 2% to 4%, and in dose ranges.

modes.label: Percent range start
modes.description: The % sign after the first figure in a risk range written as 'X% to Y%'.
modes.example: the estimated risk of major birth defects and of miscarriage in clinically recognized pregnancies is 2<<%>> to 4% and 15

modes.label: Dose or spec range start
modes.description: A number that begins a range of doses or system requirements, followed by 'to'.

card.writes: It promotes tilde-style range symbols (~), suggesting it pushes toward approximate or range notation after the first number.
card.plain: It notices the first number in a 'from X to Y' range, such as 2% to 4%.
